# Edited outside

## Open questions

- Is the price of an action a measure of trust at all, or only a measure of the attacker's budget? The question stays open because the one source that raises it — [[Sources/2026-01-10_aaaaaaaa/source#Alpha paper]] — argues from a single case, and no second source in the dossier either confirms or denies that a costly action is a trustworthy one. Someone edited this paragraph by hand after the build; the printed body hash no longer matches, and the page is long enough to pass a small word budget.
